tools.name: list_festivals
tools.description: Retrieve all Hindu festivals and sankrantis for a specific year. Use when needing a yearly overview; NOT for precise dates or future years beyond 2040. For upcoming festivals, use next_festival.

tools.name: next_festival
tools.description: Retrieve the next festival on or after a given date. Use when you need the upcoming festival. Do NOT use for a list of festivals; use list_festivals instead.

tools.name: festival_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific festival in a given year. Use when you need specific details about a festival. Do NOT use for listing multiple festivals; use list_festivals instead.

tools.name: festivals_in_month
tools.description: Retrieve festivals in a specific month and year. Use when you need a list of festivals for a particular month; NOT for upcoming festivals. Use next_festival instead.
